title: Our Home: Earth
summary: The Goldilocks zone, the atmosphere, liquid water and the magnetic field: why Earth supports life, and why we must protect it.

ib.note: Climate systems explored in MYP 4–5 and DP ESS

objectives: I can describe the conditions that make Earth habitable.
I can explain the Goldilocks zone and the natural greenhouse effect.
I can evaluate human impacts on the conditions that support life.
misconceptions: The greenhouse effect is entirely bad.
Any planet with water can support life.
